rooms.name: Path through the Forest
rooms.desc:
A rather boring path really... It's hard to make out, but it seems that
the trail leads off towards the monastary.

rooms.name: A Forest Path
rooms.desc:
The trail goes deeper into the forest, but you can make out the outline
of the Monk's Monastary further down the path.

rooms.name: Further Down the Path
rooms.desc:
You can now definitely make out the Monk's Monastary since you are almost
outside the entranceway now.

rooms.name: Outside the Monastary
rooms.desc:
This has got to be a religious building from all the chanting and humming
that you hear coming from within. You think you can hear some sounds of unarmed
battle coming from towards the back which is straight ahead.

rooms.name: Entranceway to the Monastary
rooms.desc:
To the East, a hallway leads into the rest of the monastary and the
Practice Grounds in the back. From the South you hear some chanting and
the low hum of monks in prayer.

exits.desc:
Looking south, you see the sanctum of the monastary where the monks come
to pray and meditate. In fact, there are a few there now creating all of
that wonderful chanting and humming!
You can see outside the monastary

rooms.name: Western End of Main Hallway
rooms.desc:
The hallway continues East towards the training grounds though a smaller
hallway is to the North. You see a Dining Hall to the South of here.

rooms.name: Middle of the Main Hallway
rooms.desc:
The main hallway continues to the East towards the Training Grounds and
to the West towards the Monastary's Entrance.

rooms.name: Eastern End of Main Hallway
rooms.desc:
This East-West hallway goes East towards the Training Grounds and West
towards the Monastary Entrance. You hear the sounds of unarmed combat to
the East and hear some faint humming coming back from the West.

rooms.name: Outside the Library
rooms.desc:
You are in a small hallway outside of the Library which is to the West.
To the South is the Main Hallway, to the North is a monk's cell, and the
small corridor to the East is lined with monk cells on both sides.

rooms.name: A Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This smallish hallway runs East-West and is lined with monk cells on both
sides. The cells each have a heavy curtain to provide the monks with a little
bit of privacy when they are in their rooms.

rooms.name: A Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This smallish hallway runs East-West and is lined with monk cells on both
sides. The cells each have a heavy curtain to provide the monks with a little
bit of privacy when they are in their rooms.

rooms.name: Turn in the Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
The small hallway turns West down the corridor and South towards the
Training Grounds. Monk cells are to the North and East; and you faintly hear
to sounds of unarmed combat towards the South.

rooms.name: End of a Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
A curtain covers the entrance to a monk's cell to the East of here, a small
corridor goes North to some more monk cells, and to the South is the Entrance
to the Training Grounds.

rooms.name: A Monk's Cell
rooms.desc:
A monk's private living quarters is often referred to as a cell and from
the sparseness of the furnishings and comforts of home; you can probably
guess why. In fact, the only real piece of furniture in here is a small cot
upon which the monk sleeps.

rooms.name: A Monk's Cell
rooms.desc:

the sparseness of the furnishings and comforts of home; you can probably 
guess why. In fact, the only real piece of furniture in here is a small cot
upon which the monk sleeps.

rooms.name: Working Section of Library
rooms.desc:
This Library is either very well stocked or these busy monks have been
copying a few texts and scrolls very industriously! Bookshelves are to the
North and South and the only exit is to the East. Several tables and chairs
are about this section and a desk in on the far wall.

extras.desc:
The tables are stained with ink and covered with some blank paper. You
decide that the paper would be far to heavy if you were to take any for
sale back in town. (Besides, do you really want to make the monks upset?)

Though you can obviously tell the shelves are quite full, you would have
to actually go into the section to tell what was on them.

rooms.name: Northern Bookshelves
rooms.desc:
The bookshelves are filled with various scrolls, texts, manuals, tomes,
books, and other groupings of literature. You would have to examine the
various shelves individually to see if there was anything of interest.

rooms.name: Southern Bookshelves
rooms.desc:
The bookshelves are filled with various scrolls, texts, manuals, tomes,
books and other groupings of literature. You would have to examine the
various shelves individually to see it there was anything of interest.

rooms.name: Sanctum of the Monastary
rooms.desc:
The monks gather here to pray to the gods at various times of the day,
though at any given time there is almost gauranteed to be a few monks here
chanting, praying, or humming. The Monastary Entrance is to the North and to
the East seems to be the Dining Hall were the monks eat.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Training Grounds
rooms.desc:
You see and hear unarmed combat between monks going on behind the
Master though you get the impression that you couldn't get by him unless
he thought you were worthy of testing yourself. You see several large and
imformative SIGNS hanging on the wall.

extras.desc:
You see three signs to look at: DAMAGE, ATTACKS, and SKILLS. You feel the
urge to look at them to find out some of the mysteries of the monk class.
You do not see that here.

The formula used for the number of attacks that an unarmed monk will get per
round will be: (level-1)/16 +1   --The fractional portion will provide the
probability of getting an extra attack each round. (ie. if you were VERY
lucky, a 2nd level monk could get 2 attacks every round, but probably won't)

[a few samples: Level--#Att]
 1--1.00    5--1.25    9--1.50   13--1.75   17--2.00   21--2.25   25--2.50
29--2.75   33--3.00   37--3.25   41--3.50   45--3.75   49--4.00

At the time of this area's creation, monk skills had not yet been decided
or defined on effects. As soon as it is possible, this will be altered to
reflect the new information.

Father

rooms.name: Dining Hall
rooms.desc:
A long Table fills the room and you get the impression that it probably could
seat the entire monastary at one time. Not that they would probably all eat
at the same time since someone always seems to be training or praying.

rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.desc:
The cook prepares most of the monastary's food here despite the odd hours
that certain monks keep. You see various cooking utensils, a firepit, and a
trapdoor that leads down to the Cellar. You also notice a sign on the
trapdoor that catches you eye.

extras.desc:
BOLD ADVENTURERS!!

   Recently, it seems that some nasty little monsters made a hole in our wall
dowstairs in the Cellar. We soundly trashed them and none of them have enough
courage to enter the Cellar again, however, the Monastary would appreciate it
if you would help us keep their numbers down and fear in their hearts.
   Though the Monastary could easily purge the menace, we just don't feel like
taking the time away from our prayers and training to do this. Any assistance
you provide would be appreciated and you may keep anything you find down
there as a reward for your help.

rooms.name: Cellar Under the Monastary
rooms.desc:
There is a Hole in the South wall that seems to lead to a tunnel. The
Cellar is lit up with some magical lights but the tunnel seems to be lit by
some sort of green light. The only other exit is through the trapdoor up
to the Kitchen.

rooms.name: At the Hole in the Wall
rooms.desc:
Apparently, someone or something made this hole in the wall into the
Monastary. Unfortunately, they didn't think things through and they were
completely stomped by the monks. The tunnel seems to be lit by some sort of
luminescent fungi with an erie green glow.

rooms.name: Green Glowing Intersection
rooms.desc:
This part of the tunnel is brightly lit by some sort of green, glowing
fungi. The tunnel goes to the North, East, and South.

rooms.name: Green Glowing Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel is also brightly lit by the same green, glowing fungi that
is fairly prevalent in the chamber to the East.

rooms.name: The Glowing Green Chamber
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of green fungi growing on the walls
in this largish chamber. Not only is the fungi abundant, it also gives off a
decent light source-- probably enough to read by comfortably!

rooms.name: The Glowing Green Chamber
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of green fungi growing on the walls in
this largish chamber. Not only is the fungi abundant, it also gives off a
decent light source-- probably enough to read by comfortably!

rooms.name: The Glowing Green Chamber
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of green fungi growing on the walls in
this largish chamber. Not only is the fungi abundant, it also gives off a
decent light source-- probably enough to read by comfortably!

rooms.name: The Glowing Green Chamber
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of green fungi growing on the walls in
this largish chamber. Not only is the fungi abundant, it also gives off a
decent light source-- probably enough to read by comfortably!

rooms.name: Glowing Green Passage
rooms.desc:
This passage is as brightly lit as the Glowing Chamber to the North of
here. The light seems to be coming from a strange, green fungus that covers
the walls and ceiling of the passage.

rooms.name: A Strangely Lit Passage
rooms.desc:
This passage is illuminated in the most unusual color because there seems
to be a bright, Green glow coming from the North and a not-quite as bright
Red glow coming from the West. There seems to be a small passage going to
the East of here.

rooms.name: Red Glowing Passage
rooms.desc:
This passage is fairly well lit by what seems to be some sort of strange
fungus. This paticular strain of fungi emits a bright Red glow. You can see a
chamber to the South that seems to be covered in this fungus.

rooms.name: A Dimly Lit Intersection
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of Red glowing fungus growing on the
walls of this rather large chamber. In fact, the Fungus is so abundant, you
could probably read by the light it gives off.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc:
A rather boring tunnel really that leads East and West. To the East, you
notice that there is some strangely colored light while to the West is
nothing but blackness.

rooms.name: Edge of a Deep, Dark Pit
rooms.desc:
The tunnel ends abruptly at the steep side of a Deep, Dark Pit. You think
to yourself, "This has GOT to be where all of the monsters are coming from!"

exits.desc:
Looking down, you feel that you should probably go down there and see if
you can clear out the monster infestation.... then again, maybe someone else
will do it for the monastary.

rooms.name: You change you mind and go back!
rooms.desc:
As you start down, you hear some strange growls and snorts from below and
you suddenly think, "What if there is something down there that is MUCH
tougher than the things that are up here?  What if the things up here are
actually trying to get away from something down there?"
   You suddenly remember that you were supposed to be somewhere (well, 
anywhere besides here would do nicely) and decide to go back.

rooms.name: The Glowing Red Chamber
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of Red glowing fungus growing on the
walls of this rather large chamber. In fact, the Fungus is so abundant, you
could probably read by the light it gives off.

rooms.name: A Glowing Red Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel would be a rather unremarkable North-East tunnel if it wasn't
for the very unusual fungus growing all over the ceiling and walls. This
fungus emits a bright Red glow that enables you to see quite well.

rooms.name: Bend in the Red Glowing Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel bends to the West and South here. As before, the walls and
ceilings of the tunnel are covered with an unusual fungus that emits a bright
red light that enables you to see.

rooms.name: The Glowing Red Chamber
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of Red glowing fungus growing on the
walls of this rather large chamber. In fact, the Fungus is so abundant, you
could probably read by the light it gives off.

rooms.name: The Glowing Red Chamber
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of Red glowing fungus growing on the
walls of this rather large chamber. In fact, the Fungus is so abundant, you
could probably read by the light it gives off.

rooms.name: The Glowing Red Chamber
rooms.desc:
You can hardly believe the amount of Red glowing fungus growing on the
walls of this rather large chamber. In fact, the Fungus is so abundant, you
could probably read by the light it gives off.

rooms.name: A Small Passage
rooms.desc:
This seems to be a recently dug passage that seems to have broken through
the wall to the South. You are not sure, but you think that you can smell
the wonderful odor of baking Pipeweed Bread coming from the hole to the South.

254.name: The jackalwere
254.long: A jackalwere looks at you.. You feel sleepy
254.desc: It is a jackal-like creature, that has partially taken the shape of a man.

257.name: An ogre magi
257.long: An ogre magi stands here, feasting on human flesh.
257.desc: He is large, and vaguely oriental.

691.name: the Monk Guildmaster
691.long: Cain the monk guildmaster is standing here.
691.desc:
He is positively the fastest, and fiercest fighter you have ever seen
in your entire life.   Every movement of his body is a demonstration of just
how fluid and beautiful movement can be.

1032.name: a shiriff
1032.long: A shiriff of the Shire looks for the lost halfling youth.
1032.desc:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.
He looks at you, smiles and asks you if you have seen a halfling youth
somewhere outside the shire.

1701.name: the human monk
1701.long: A human monk is quietly resting here.
1701.desc:
A closer look reveals that this monk is obviously somewhat skilled though
not quite a master in unarmed combat.

1702.name: the human monk
1702.long: A human monk is sitting here, copying some manuscripts.
1702.desc:
This chap spends almost all of the time that he is not improving his
skills in unarmed combat by copying fading manuscripts and books.

1703.name: the dwarven monk
1703.long: A dwarven monk is quietly resting here.
1703.desc:
A closer look reveals that this monk is obviously somewhat skilled though
not quite a master in unarmed combat.

1704.name: the female monk
1704.long: A human female monk is sitting here praying and humming.
1704.desc:
A quite attractive female, however, from the calluses on her hands and
feet, it would be advisable for you not to try anything on her that might
get her upset.

1705.name: the human monk
1705.long: A human monk is here going about his daily duties.
1705.desc:
From the way that this monk walks and carries himself you can tell that
he is fairly new to being a monk as he seems too much like a normal person
(except for the monk robes he is wearing).

1706.name: the human monk
1706.long: A human monk is sitting here praying and humming.
1706.desc:
You think that this young man is probably fairly new to being a monk as
occasionally he slightly stumbles over a difficult phrase in his prayers.

1707.name: the human monk
1707.long: A human monk is resting here.
1707.desc:
This poor fellow has spent the day training, cleaning, praying, and
eating few small meals. All he really wants to do is just stay here and
rest for a week.

1708.name: the human monk
1708.long: A human monk is here maintaining the library.
1708.desc:
This lucky chap has the easy job for this week as he gets to give his
tired body a rest while he goes through the books - sorting and dusting as
he goes around.

1709.name: the human monk
1709.long: A human monk is here cleaning up the monastery.
1709.desc:
This poor guy gets the unenvied job of cleaning the monastery. Not only
does he have to clean the floors and walls, but he has to pick all of the
loose trash and stuff that the occasional adventurer leaves lying around.

1710.name: the female monk
1710.long: A human female monk is resting here.
1710.desc:
A few human females just get fed up with the troubles that men cause them
so they come to the monastery to find out how to defend themselves. This
one is probably no exception to the majority.

1711.name: the dwarven monk
1711.long: A dwarven monk is here going about his daily duties.
1711.desc:
From the way that this monk walks and acts, you can tell that he is
still fairly new as he grumbles as much as most dwarves when looked at.

1712.name: the dwarven monk
1712.long: A dwarven monk is here snoring loudly.
1712.desc:
This tough little guy is all tuckered out from a full day of being a
monk. Though none could probably sleep through his snores, it would not
be a good idea to wake him and tell him about it.

1713.name: the human monk
1713.long: A human monk is here going about his daily duties.
1713.desc:
From the way that this monk walks and acts, you get the impression that
this guy is quite confident in his abilities to handle any problems that
might come his way.

1714.name: the human monk
1714.long: A human monk is sitting here going over new acquisitions and making notes.
1714.desc:
Though very skilled in the arts of unarmed combat, this quiet fellow
likes to spend a lot of his time taking care of the library and trying to
increase the contents of the library.

1715.name: the human monk
1715.long: A human monk is sitting here praying and humming.
1715.desc:
This monk has some noticeable calluses built up on his hands and feet
and you get the impression that a lot of time went into getting them that
way.

1716.name: Dorek the monk
1716.long: Dorek the human monk is walking around looking big and strong.
1716.desc:
This monk is quite strong looking and if he wasn't a monk, you would
probably find this guy working as a bouncer at a bar.

1717.name: Ron the monk
1717.long: Ron the monk is sitting here drinking some beer and telling army stories.
1717.desc:
This particular fellow has close cropped hair that came from when he was
serving in Shadowdale's Cityguards. He also seems to be able put down a good
amount of beer as he is often draining his mug.

sounds.near:
Ron the monk chuckles over some joke, raises his mug, declares "Compai!",
   drains his mug, and then refills it from a small beer barrel.
sounds.far: You here some muffled laughter nearby (kind of like a party).

1718.name: the Grand Master of Monks
1718.long: You see a human casually chopping up a few logs with.... HIS HANDS!
1718.desc:
He calmly looks you over with a very impassive face. You also realize
that this guy could easily rip you apart with his bare hands from the way
that he can chop those logs. He also carries around a pouch with the money
of the monastery (after all, can you think of a safer place?).

3062.name: The black cat
3062.desc:
A cute and furry black cat.  It looks so cute you want to take it home with
you and hug it and pet it and feed it and love it and......

3066.name: The vampire bat
3066.desc:
A vampire bat hovers here, ready to go for your neck.

WATCH OUT!

OUCH!  That hurt!

9005.name: The baby llama
9005.long: The baby llama is here, looking cute and playful.
9005.desc: She just looks so darn CUTE!

9006.name: The scruffy mutt
9006.long: The scruffy mutt is here, digging for bones.

1.name: a leather training helm
1.long: A leather training helm is lying on the ground.

12.name: a complimentary bread
12.long: A complimentary bread has been left here.

13.name: a complimentary cup
13.long: A complimentary cup has been set here.

extras.desc: It is a large simple cup.

30.name: A pile of scraps
30.long: There is a bunch of scraps here, piled up into a very very very small heap

63.name: A big rock
63.long: A big rock is lying on the ground here

65.name: A small boulder
65.long: A small boulder is lying on the ground here

1701.name: a small cot
1701.long: A small cot lies in the corner of the room.

1702.name: a string of prayer beads
1702.long: A small bead necklace lies in a pile here.

1704.name: a vial of Holy water
1704.long: A small vial of what appears to be water is on the ground.

1705.name: a Holy wafer
1705.long: A small, light colored wafer with a Holy symbol on it lies here.

1706.name: a saffron colored robe
1706.long: A pile of saffron colored cloth lies on the ground here.

1707.name: a ream of white paper
1707.long: A neatly stacked ream of white paper lies here.

1708.name: a piece of luminous green fungus
1708.long: A piece of luminous green fungus is lying here.

1709.name: a piece of luminous red fungus
1709.long: A piece of lunimous red fungus is lying here.

1710.name: a small cask of wine
1710.long: A small cask of wine lies on the ground.

1712.name: a narrow oak bookshelf
1712.long: A narrow oak bookshelf is here filled with various documents and texts.

1713.name: a wide oak bookshelf
1713.long: A wide oak bookshelf is here filled with various documents and texts.

1714.name: a tall oak bookshelf
1714.long: A tall oak bookshelf is here filled with various documents and texts.

1715.name: a short oak bookshelf
1715.long: A short oak bookshelf is here filled with various documents and texts.

1716.name: a long oak bookshelf
1716.long: A long oak bookshelf is here filled with various documents and texts.

1717.name: a brown history book
1717.long: A brown history book is resting here.

extras.desc:
The book is titled "The Recent History of the Western Lands" which seems to
include a history of Shadowdale and the surrounding lands.

1718.name: a tan history book
1718.long: a tan history book is resting here.

extras.desc:
The book is titled "The History of the Eastern Lands" which seems to include
a history of Old and New Thalos, with some mention made to the Great Eastern
Desert and the nomads who live there.

1719.name: a black history book
1719.long: A black history book is lying here.

extras.desc:
The book is titled "The History of the Middle Lands" which seems to include a
history of the Mountains and the groups of people that tend to live there.
References are made to the goblins, harpies, drow, gypsy villagers, and the
strange and sometimes dangerous monsters that live there.

1720.name: a small, black leather book
1720.long: A small, black leather book is lying here.

extras.desc:
This small book is actually a journal of a brave adventurer who journeyed
into the Abyss and made his way out again. Unfoutunately, the script seems
hastily written and messy so it would take a long time to decipher it.

1721.name: a thick textbook
1721.long: A thick textbook lies here heavily.

extras.desc:
This rather large and heavy text is titled "The Laws of the Physical World".
The language is rather wordy and uses very long and vague words that would
probably only interest mages or scholars with plenty of time on their hands.

1722.name: a large textbook
1722.long: A rather large textbook lies here heavily.

extras.desc:
This large textbook is titled "The Laws of a Civilized World" and is a rather
boring list of laws and customs in various parts of the world such as Thalos
and Shadowdale.

1723.name: a small, brown leather book
1723.long: A small, brown leather book rests here.

extras.desc:
This book is titled "The Use of Large Area Fire Spells" and seems to go into
some detail about the use and casting of the spells 'burning hands' and the
ever popular, 'fireball'.

1724.name: a small manual
1724.long: A small manual is lying here.
stats: cure light, cure critic, cure serious

extras.desc:
This manuscript, written in a very neat handwriting, is obviously the work of a
high priest. It discusses the prayers and preperations that seemed to help her
in healing the wounded. It is divided into three parts: "The Curing of Light
Wounds", "The Curing of More Serious Wounds", and "Curing the Critically
Injured".

1725.name: a small leather book
1725.long: A small leather book is lying here.
stats: create food, create water, heroes feast

extras.desc:
This small, tightly bound leather book is titled "Feeding the Faithful" and
includes the prayers and preparations that a high priest uses when she is
conjuring food for her faithful followers. This book has three sections:
"Creation of Food", "Creation of Water", and "A Rewarding Feast".

1726.name: a forest green book
1726.long: A forest green book is lying here.

extras.desc:
This oddly colored book was obviously written by a druid (that probably would
explain the color) and dicusses various trees and such that live in the forest.
One thing that does catch your eye is a chapter about telling which trees are
able to cast spells. Apparently, Eucalyptus trees and the trees that "shiver"
do not cast spells, but the trees that "moan" do.

This manual is titled "The Conflict Between the Aborigines and Roos" and tells
about how the Aborigines and Roos are constantly fighting each other. Though
nobody knows what started the fighting (not even they remember anymore), some
historians believe it has something to do with the death of a Roo princess and
an Aborigine prince.

1728.name: a map
1728.long: A rolled up piece of paper is lying here.

1730.name: a wood bound book
1730.long: A book, nicely bound in a sturdy wood binding.

extras.desc:
This rather sturdy, wood-bound book is titled "Surviving In the Wilderness".
It covers some interesting material regarding living off of the land, foraging
for food, and finding potable water sources.

1731.name: an encyclopedia vol. A
1731.long: A hide bound book with a large A on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
A. Some of the entries look like these:
Anaconda- Anacondas don't want "none" unless you've got buns, hun'.
Aphrodesiac- For some reason, females seem to really like a good aphrodesiac.
   You should try some sometime... you may be surprised!

1732.name: an encyclopedia vol. B
1732.long: A hide bound book with a large B on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
B. Some of the entries look like these:
Bozo, clown- known for his big red nose, this joker is real annoying.
Bitter Blade- This very evil item has a real attitude and has been know to use
   people for pointless violence.

1733.name: an encyclopedia vol. C
1733.long: A hide bound book with a large C on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
C. Some of the entries look like these:
The "Cub*" Clan- this group has been know to wander around the world with no
   paticular goal except to just see what it can kill.
Club- very effective in the harvesting of seal fur.

1734.name: an encyclopedia vol. D
1734.long: A hide bound book with a large D on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
D. Some of the entries look like these:
Dracolich- often underrated (at least recently), the dracolich is quite deadly
   to even powerful opponents.
Dice, fuzzy- often seen hanging from the top of various "mounts" these cute
   little things are quite soft and warm.

1735.name: an encyclopedia vol. E
1735.long: A hide bound book with a large A on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
E. Some of the entries look like these:
Enfan- little child-like creatures... so cute you want to kill them on sight!
Energy bow- these rather "strange" bows don't even shoot anything, people can
  only beat others over the head with them. Despite this, they are highly
  sought after.

1736.name: an encyclopedia vol. F
1736.long: A hide bound book with a large F on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
F. Some of the entries look like these:
Friend- though most people claim to be one, you never can seem to find one when
   you need one the most... especially on wednesday nights.
Flaming scorpion- a very potent drink from New Thalos.

1737.name: an encyclopedia vol. G
1737.long: A hide bound book with a large G on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
G. Some of the entries look like these:
Golem- there are so many variaties of golems that it would be impossible to
   name them all... in fact, more are being made today than ever before!
Gold- for some reason, this soft metal has a high value though one would wonder
   why since you can't even make a decent weapon out of it.

1738.name: an encyclopedia vol. H
1738.long: A hide bound book with a large H on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
H. Some of the entries look like these:
Humans- while good in a fight, they just lack the concentration for serious
   study of most other disciplines.
Halberd- if you have the strength for one, a halberd is a fairly sturdy weapon
   with fairly decent damage and medium upkeep.

1739.name: an encyclopedia vol. I
1739.long: A hide bound book with a large I on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
I. Some of the entries look like these:
Ice, Vanilla- an individual with a high opinion of his singing and dancing
   skills who said "Word" to your mother. (personally I'd beat him up)
Ice Boots- these are for people that enjoy getting cold feet (others just seem
   to lose them or something since they disappear after a while).

1740.name: an encyclopedia vol. J
1740.long: A hide bound book with a large J on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
J. Some of the entries look like these:
Jugglernaut- this stupid oaf couldn't juggle two items, let alone the several
   that he tries to toss around. Fortunately, he gets a large allowance that
   goes to replace the items he is constantly dropping.
Jello pudding pop- a truly wonderful invention, life would just not be the same
   without an occasional one of these.

1741.name: an encyclopedia vol. K
1741.long: A hide bound book with a large K on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
K. Some of the entries look like these:
Kanga-Roo, Captain- leader of the Roo forces in their fued against their hated
   enemies, the Aborigines. Fortunately, the Aborigine Chief is just as inept
   or else the war would have ended in defeat for the Roos.
Knife- a very useful invention, the knife helps us in many ways. When one is
   done with a knife, it is also discovered that it fits nicely in someone's
   back. [See "Friend" in vol. F]

1742.name: an encyclopedia vol. L
1742.long: A hide bound book with a large L on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
L. Some of the entries look like these:
Lamia- for some reason, these rather noisy and annoying creatures seem to hang
   out in Old Thalos in large numbers.
Light source- for some reason, these always seem to expire right after you flee
   so you do not have any idea where you are or how to get out.

1743.name: an encyclopedia vol. M
1743.long: A hide bound book with a large M on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
M. Some of the entries look like these:
Mime- these guys must have a serious mental problem! If I ever started acting
   like one of them, I'd pray that someone would kill me!
Musical Instruments- while many types are out there, unfortunately, there are
   just as many people that think that they can use them and couldn't carry
   a tune if it were glued to them and weighed nothing.

1744.name: an encyclopedia vol. N
1744.long: A hide bound book with a large N on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
N. Some of the entries look like these:
Nomad- talk about crazy, these people seem to get some sort of thrill out of
   living in a hot, dry place with little water. At least some carry money.
Nail- useful in construction, these small pieces of metal can also be used to
   nail someone to the wall.

1745.name: an encyclopedia vol. O
1745.long: A hide bound book with a large O on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
O. Some of the entries look like these:
Otyugh- these vile and disgusting creatures live an filth and trash, but why do
   some of them seem to have a more pleasant personality than politicians?
Onyx- another highly valued material, things made of this stuff tend to be
   highly praised until their power is made more realistic.

1746.name: an encyclopedia vol. P
1746.long: A hide bound book with a large P on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
P. Some of the entries look like these:
Purple Worm- this large creature lives in the Desert and is always looking for
   something to snack on. Also quite sociable, he is often known to have even
   univited visitors for lunch.
Pick- a useful tool in digging all of the graves for the people who die a bit
   too often.

1747.name: an encyclopedia vol. Q
1747.long: A hide bound book with a large Q on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
Q. Some of the entries look like these:
Quickling- these annoying little faeries must be on drugs! Nothing normal in
   this world would move as fast as they do if they weren't on speed.
Quickness, Sword of- even if you are not so quick (checked your intelligence
   recently?), this sword will help quicken your speed in combat.

1748.name: an encyclopedia vol. R
1748.long: A hide bound book with a large R on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
R. Some of the entries look like these:
Rat- there are many varieties of rat (flying, sewer, wererat, ...) you will
   also discover that while not all, a few are good eatin' if you cook them
   properly (the radioactive rats are sought by the best chefs).
Rapier- a useful weapon, it can really help get your point across if you get
   in an argument.

1749.name: an encyclopedia vol. S
1749.long: A hide bound book with a large S on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
S. Some of the entries look like these:
Shark- they are waiting for you with big, nasty, pointy teeth. They've got a
   mean streak a mile wide!
Sting- not only a popular weapon, Sting also makes a fairly good living as
   a rock musician.

1750.name: an encyclopedia vol. T
1750.long: A hide bound book with a large T on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
T. Some of the entries look like these:
Tasmanian Devil- a rather nasty and viscious beast, it was captured by several
   Roo soldiers by order of their queen. They had hoped that they could train
   it to kill the Aborigines, but they have had no success. It is currently
   kept in a locked cage for which the queen has the only key.
Two-handed sword- large and heavy, very few people are able to wield it. Those
   that can, however, find it to be a fairly useful and damaging weapon.

1751.name: an encyclopedia vol. U
1751.long: A hide bound book with a large U on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
U. Some of the entries look like these:
Unicorn- these horny horses only go for those that are pure good. Most people,
   however, do not want to admit that these steeds will let them ride.
Ukelele- a kind of small guitar, most serious muscians don't consider this
   instrument a real instrument for entertaining anyone except children.

1752.name: an encyclopedia vol. V
1752.long: A hide bound book with a large V on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
V. Some of the entries look like these:
Vampire- these bloodsuckers are pure evil and tend to ruin a person's day
   (or night rather) whenever they feel hungry.
Vorpal Sword- a kind of nifty sword, when properly made, these swords can do
   quite a fair amount of damage.

1753.name: an encyclopedia vol. W
1753.long: A hide bound book with a large W on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
W. Some of the entries look like these:
Wolf- these guys are just big puppies gone bad. Now they attack almost anyone
   on sight just because they had a bad day.
Whip, snake_headed- used by those silly drow priestesses; the larger ones can
   do a decent amount of damage thought they have a detrimental affect on the
   wielder.

1754.name: an encyclopedia vol. X
1754.long: A hide bound book with a large X OBon the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
X. Some of the entries look like these:
Xenia, the Silver Dragon- quite large and ancient, this dragon hangs out in the
   frozen wastelands of Artica.
Xylophone- this unusual instrument allows one to fine tune other musical
   instruments and to play all sorts of music as it can range from very high
   notes to very low ones.

1758.name: an iron nail
1758.long: A small metal nail is lying on the ground.

1760.name: a xylophone
1760.long:
A strange looking instrument that resembles a table with many small metal
  plates of different sizes all over it.

1762.name: the monastary's money pouch
1762.long: WOW! Some FOOL has just left a large pouch of GOLD lying here!

3000.long: A beer barrel has been left here.

3010.long: A loaf of bread has been left here.

3043.name: a leather jacket
3043.long: A tough leather jacket is lying on the ground.

3057.name: a silver potion
3057.long: A small silver vial rests here.

extras.desc: The potion has a red cross on the side.

3102.name: a cup
3102.long: A cup has been set here.

extras.desc: It is a large simple cup.

16710.name: a crystal potion
16710.long: A crystal potion has been placed here.

16711.name: an azure potion
16711.long: A azure potion has been placed here.

18255.name: a simmering crimson potion
18255.long: A simmering crimson potion has been left here.

extras.desc: It has a nasty crimson color, and it simmers with heat.

40003.long: Gonji, the staff of monks lies here
